name: webtools
description: A repo of small web tools sharing one toolchain. Each lives under tools/<name>.

scripts.// prepare: Points git at .githooks so the commit-message check installs itself with the dependencies. `|| true` because this also runs inside the Docker build, where there is no repository and no git.
scripts.// e2e:downloader:sniffer: The slow half, kept out of `e2e:downloader` so the suite a developer runs between edits stays fast: the API launches its own Chromium and a probe takes 10-20 s. Its own config rather than its own project, because Playwright starts every `webServer` in a config whatever `--project` selects. See tools/downloader/playwright.sniffer.config.ts.
scripts.// e2e:serve: The downloader's, from before there was a second tool to disambiguate against. Its playwright.config.ts names it.
scripts.e2e:serve: npm run build -w @downloader/web && node --import tsx tools/downloader/api/src/main.ts
scripts.e2e:planner:serve: npm run build -w @planner/web && node --import tsx tools/planner/api/src/main.ts
scripts.// status: Where things stand, computed from ticket frontmatter on every run and stored nowhere. `-- --ready`, `-- --json`, `-- --prs`, `-- --tool <name>`, `-- --show <id>`, `-- --markdown`. It writes no file: repo-2 retired the generated pages `--write` used to maintain — see docs/adr/003-the-status-page-is-generated.md and its amendment.
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
